description.value: Rollzzy is a fast-casual Indian street food chain specializing in authentic Kathi rolls — handcrafted paratha wraps with over 20 varieties of spiced meat, paneer, and vegetarian fillings rooted in Kolkata street food tradition. The Commercial Drive location sits on one of Vancouver's most bike-friendly corridors, a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Drive. Part of TGI Foods Corp., the brand has expanded to eight-plus Lower Mainland locations while emphasizing accessibility and authenticity.
